aggregation.error: any incomplete or ambiguous population/read/parse state yields ERROR; no partial PASS

password_state_rule: the second field of the matching /etc/shadow record must be non-empty; non-empty lock markers, hashes and other non-empty crypt-field representations satisfy the source criterion that the field is not empty
population_rule: each syntactically valid unique /etc/passwd username must have exactly one syntactically valid /etc/shadow record
source_scope: local Linux user accounts whose account population is represented by /etc/passwd and password/lock state by /etc/shadow
